notes: Robobet is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its argument-free constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 ROBOBET to msg.sender, the launch factory. It has no administrative roles, transfer fees, or externally callable mint or burn functions. No application contracts are deployed. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and the total supply.
